dialogue.content: （本日はお時間いただきありがとうございます。どうぞよろしくお願い致します。お時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きますので、もう少々お待ちください。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for taking the time today. I look forward to our session. We will begin at the scheduled time, so please wait just a little longer.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします。何か扱いたい内容があったら教えてください)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Please let me know if there is anything you would like to address.)

dialogue.content: （お時間になりましたが、入られていらっしゃいますでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (It's time to begin. Have you been able to join?)

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm here.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。初めに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: ５８歳、女です．この先のことが不安で．
dialogue.English: I am 58, female. I'm anxious about the future.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。ご不安を抱えていらっしゃるのですね。どのようなことが不安かもう少し具体的にお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I understand you're feeling anxious. Could you tell me a bit more specifically what you're worried about?

dialogue.content: お金のこと、家族のこと、母の介護のこと、です
dialogue.English: It's about money, my family, and caring for my mother.

dialogue.content: 様々なご不安を抱えながら過ごされているのですね。お母様の介護もあると大変ですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're dealing with various anxieties in your daily life. Having to care for your mother must be challenging.

dialogue.content: 介護と言っても、今はたいしたことないのですが。
dialogue.English: I say 'caregiving,' but it's not that much right now.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。一つ一つお伺いしながら進められればと思いますが、「先のことがご不安」とのことですが、ご自身の中で一番気がかりなことは何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. I'd like to go through things one by one if that's okay. You mentioned that you are 'anxious about the future.' What is your biggest concern?

dialogue.content: 一番？　なんだろう
dialogue.English: The biggest one? I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: もしどれも同じようにということであれば、こちらから質問させていただければと思いますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If they all feel about the same, I can ask you some questions to guide us. Would that be alright?

dialogue.content: 同じようにというか、みんな混ざってって感じでしょうか。質問された方が話しやすいかもしれません
dialogue.English: It's not so much that they're the same, but more that they're all mixed together. It might be easier for me to talk if you ask questions.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。色々なご不安が混ざって複雑に絡み合っているのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I understand that your various anxieties are mixed up and intertwined.

dialogue.content: それでは、まずはご家族についてお伺いできればと思いますが、ご家族構成を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: In that case, let's start with your family. Could you tell me about your family members?

dialogue.content: 夫、自分、娘が1人．母は車で5分ほどのところで一人暮らしです
dialogue.English: There's my husband, myself, and one daughter. My mother lives alone about a 5-minute drive away.

dialogue.content: お母様がお一人暮らしだと何かと心配ですね。今はまだそれほどでもないということでしたが、介護については今どのような状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Having your mother living alone must be worrisome in many ways. You mentioned it's not too much yet, but what is the current situation with her caregiving?

dialogue.content: 要支援2なので，家の中のことはたいてい自分でできます．
dialogue.English: She’s certified as Support Level 2, so she can do most things around the house by herself.

dialogue.content: 心臓に持病があるので，医者がよいと、買い物に付き添ったりくらいです．
dialogue.English: She has a chronic heart condition, so I go with her to the doctor and accompany her for shopping, that sort of thing.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。持病を持たれていることも心配ですよね。病院や買い物に付き添われるのも大変かと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Having a chronic condition is worrisome. Accompanying her to the hospital and for shopping can also be demanding.

dialogue.content: 結構時間を取られたり、予定が立てられなかったりというのはありますね
dialogue.English: Yes, it can take up a lot of time and make it hard to make plans.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ご自身の時間を削ることにもなりますよね。先のこともそうですが、今の状況も大変なのではないかと感じましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine. It must cut into your own time. In addition to your concerns about the future, I sense that your current situation might also be difficult. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: あまり大変とは思ってないです．今くらいですめばよいけれとど、確実に歳をとって弱っていくので，それが心配です．
dialogue.English: I don't really think it's that difficult. It would be fine if it stayed at this level, but she will definitely get older and frailer, and that's what worries me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、やはり今よりも今後の方がご不安ということですね。ご高齢の方は年々心配が大きくなりますよね。今はお一人でお母様をサポートされている状況ですか？
dialogue.English: I understand, so you're more anxious about the future than the present. Worries tend to grow each year when it comes to elderly parents, don't they? Are you currently the only one supporting your mother?

dialogue.content: 兄が母の近くに住んでいますが、離婚して1人だし、あまりあてにはしてないです。兄の息子が、よく助けてくれます。あと、わたしの娘も．
dialogue.English: My older brother lives near my mother, but he's divorced and lives alone, so I don't really count on him. My brother's son helps out a lot. My daughter does, too.

dialogue.content: 甥っ子さんや娘さんのお手伝いがあるのですね。それは少し心強いですね。
dialogue.English: So your nephew and daughter help out. That must be reassuring.

dialogue.content: かなり助かってます
dialogue.English: They're a huge help.

dialogue.content: ただ、甥も30近いのに独り身で、母の心配の種です．
dialogue.English: However, my nephew is almost 30 and still single, which is a source of worry for my mother.

dialogue.content: それは良かったです。でも今後負担が増えるかもと思うと、不安は拭えませんね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. But I can see why the anxiety lingers when you think about how the burden might increase in the future.

dialogue.content: きっと甥っ子さんに負担をかけ続けるわけには行かないというお気持ちもありますよね。
dialogue.English: I imagine you also feel that you can't keep relying on your nephew indefinitely.

dialogue.content: 先ほどお金とご家族のこともとありましたが、お母様意外でご家族についてご不安なことはありますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned money and family earlier. Besides your mother, do you have any other anxieties about your family?

dialogue.content: 負担ですか？　わたしは自分の親だし、負担とも思いませんが、甥にはいつまでもさせられませんね、
dialogue.English: A burden? She’s my own parent, so I don’t see it as a burden, but I can’t have my nephew keep doing this forever.

dialogue.content: 娘がまだ学生なので、先が見えないっていう不安です．お金は未知です
dialogue.English: My daughter is still a student, so there's an anxiety about her future being uncertain. The money situation is an unknown.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。娘さんは学生さんとのことですが、大学生ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. You mentioned your daughter is a student; is she in college?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 「先が見えない不安」というのはもう少し具体的にはどういったことか、教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little more specifically what you mean by 'anxiety about her future being uncertain'?

dialogue.content: 一人っ子だし、私たちは先に死ぬし、ちゃんと家族を作って生きていってほしい。
dialogue.English: She's an only child, and we will pass away before she does. I just want her to be able to build her own family and live a good life.

dialogue.content: でも、今のご時世、よくわからないことが起こるし
dialogue.English: But these days, so many unpredictable things happen.

dialogue.content: そうお思いなのですね。優しいお母様ですね。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. You are a very caring mother.

dialogue.content: 世の中に親って、こんなもんなんじゃないですか
dialogue.English: Isn't this how all parents are?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません。ただ、娘さんの将来を思ったり、幸せを願ったりするのは、素敵なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Perhaps so. Still, thinking about your daughter’s future and wishing for her happiness is a wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: 先ほど「お金については未知」とありましたが、今は具体的な不安はないということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that 'the money situation is an unknown.' Does that mean you don't have any specific financial worries at the moment?

dialogue.content: 今は大丈夫です。共働きでしたから
dialogue.English: We're fine for now. We were both working.

dialogue.content: そうですか。それは少し安心ですね。「共働きだった」ということは今はどちらかはお仕事されていないということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That's somewhat reassuring. When you say you 'were' both working, does that mean one or both of you are not working now?

dialogue.content: 夫はもう定年退職しています．わたしも、早期退職しました．
dialogue.English: My husband has already retired. I took early retirement as well.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。長年お仕事されてこられて、すごいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's impressive that you both worked for so many years.

dialogue.content: これからのお金についての不安ですが、何か具体的に思い当たるものはありますか？
dialogue.English: Regarding financial worries going forward, is there anything specific that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 何歳まで生きるのか、ですね．
dialogue.English: How long we’ll live, really.

dialogue.content: それなりの退職金はもらってますし、年金もあるはずですが、それが尽きたら終わりですからね
dialogue.English: We received a decent retirement package, and we should have our pensions, but once that runs out, it's over.

dialogue.content: 娘には頼るわけにはいかないし
dialogue.English: And we can't rely on our daughter.

dialogue.content: なるほど。それはご不安ですね。これまでお二人で働かれていたので、余計にそう思うかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I understand. That must be worrying. Since you've both been working until now, you might feel it even more.

dialogue.content: 余計にそう思う？　そこはよくわかりませんが．まぁ、不安です．
dialogue.English: Even more so? I'm not sure I follow that part. But well, I am anxious.

dialogue.content: 生活のサイズダウンができないってことですか？
dialogue.English: Are you saying it's because we can't downsize our lifestyle?

dialogue.content: お二人のご収入と年金の差額があるのではないかと思った次第です。違和感ありました申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I was thinking there might be a gap between your previous combined income and your pensions. I'm sorry if that felt off.

dialogue.content: ？　まぁ、正直、あまりお金の心配はしないで暮らしてきたので，年金のこととかもよくわからないんですよね．
dialogue.English: ? Well, to be honest, we've lived without worrying too much about money, so I don't really understand much about pensions and things like that.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。今後について夫さんとお話しされたりはしていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you discussed the future with your husband at all?

dialogue.content: 夫は楽観的といいますか、なんとかなるんじゃないのって感じです．自由に生きてます．
dialogue.English: My husband is optimistic, or rather, he has a 'things will work out' attitude. He lives freely.

dialogue.content: 俺たちは大丈夫だろうけど、娘は大変だろうなって、人ごとみたい
dialogue.English: He says things like, 'We'll probably be fine, but our daughter will have it tough,' as if it's someone else's problem.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。相談者さまはそれについてどう思われましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. And how did that make you feel?

dialogue.content: どう？　夫に何かを期待してないので。
dialogue.English: How? I don't expect anything from my husband.

dialogue.content: 娘には心配のないようにしておいてあげたいとは思ってます。
dialogue.English: I do want to make sure our daughter has nothing to worry about.

dialogue.content: 娘さん思いですね。夫さんに期待できない理由などは何かあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You're very thoughtful about your daughter. Is there a particular reason you feel you can't expect anything from your husband?

dialogue.content: 自由に生きてますから．
dialogue.English: Because he lives freely.

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ、「自由に」とはどのような感じか教えていただいても良いですか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me what you mean by 'living freely'?

dialogue.content: いろいろ話していて、漠然と心配だったことが、いろいろ具体的になって、よけいに心配になってきました．
dialogue.English: As we've been talking, the things I was vaguely worried about have become more specific, and now I'm even more worried.

dialogue.content: 夫は家族の一員としての役目はしていますが、基本的に自分のやりたいことを優先するので，少なくともわたしにはそう見えるので，期待しない方がいいんだということを学びました．
dialogue.English: My husband fulfills his role as a family member, but he basically prioritizes what he wants to do—at least that’s how it looks to me—so I’ve learned it’s better not to expect things from him.

dialogue.content: 不仲なわけではないのでしょうが、何かを相談しようとも思いません．
dialogue.English: It's not that we don't get along, but I don't even think about consulting him on anything.

dialogue.content: なるほど。夫さんに相談できないとお思いなのですね。それはきっとおつらいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel you can't consult your husband. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: つらくはないです．順序よく逝ってくれたら、後始末をしっかりしていこうと思ってます．
dialogue.English: It's not difficult. If he passes away in the natural order of things, I'm prepared to handle everything properly afterwards.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。具体的になって余計に心配になることもあるかと思います。一方で、具体的になるからこそ、解決に向かう糸口も見つけられると思うのですが、いかがでしょうか。本日はお時間は無くなってきましたが、次回は具体的な不安を一緒に解消できればと思います。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you view it. I understand that things can become more worrying as they become more specific. On the other hand, I believe that making them specific is also how we can find a path toward a solution. What do you think? Our time is running out for today, but next time, I'd like to work with you on resolving these specific anxieties.

dialogue.content: 自分でしっかり考えます．
dialogue.English: I’ll think it through carefully on my own.

dialogue.content: 相談者様の不安が一つ一つ解消できるよういつでもサポートできればと思いますので、またぜひご相談にいらして下さい。
dialogue.English: I'm always here to support you in resolving your anxieties one by one, so please feel free to come back for another session anytime.

dialogue.content: この相談って、次回があるんですね．知りませんでした．
dialogue.English: Oh, these counseling sessions can have a next time? I didn't know that.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしければ、本日の内容を別の相談員にも共有して、続きから始めることも可能です。
dialogue.English: Yes, if you'd like, we can share what we discussed today with another counselor and you can continue from where we left off.

dialogue.content: なんだか、将来の心配が増してしまいました．漠然とじゃなくなったのは良いこととして、自分でしっかり考えます．
dialogue.English: I feel like my worries about the future have just increased. I suppose it's a good thing they're no longer vague, but I'll think it through carefully on my own.

dialogue.content: ご不安が増えたこと、力不足で申し訳ありません。いつでもサポートできればと思いますので、またぜひご利用下さい。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I’m sorry that your anxiety has increased; my apologies for not being more helpful. We’re here to support you anytime, so please feel free to use the service again. Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。終了ボタン押させて頂きます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I will now end the session.)
